title: Najaf se Liye Qafela Chala Mai Chala Karbala
body:
Najaf Se Liye khafela Chala Mai chala Karbala,
Hai Paidal Safar Ye Mera
Chala Mai chala Karbala-2
1) Mai Hun Matimi Maula Shabbir ka,
Mere Saat Hai Fatima Ki Dua,
Liye Parchame Bawafa.. chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
2) Sowe Roza-e
Azadarun ka Ek Samandar Chala,
Yahan Zawwari Karne Chala.
Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
3) Ali Murtuza Mujh se Rasi Howe,
Nabi Mustafa Mujh se Razi Howe,
Howa Razi Mera Khuda.
Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
4) Labun Pe Hain Noha Nigahein Hain Nam,
Jai Shahe Shaheedan ka Sene Me Gham,
Hai Dil Me Ali ki Wila..
Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
5) Baraye Azadar Har ek Gaam,
Niyaaz-e-Hussaini ka Hai Ehtemaam,
Sabeelon ka hai Silsila.
Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
6)Hain Kamsin Jawa'n bodhay Bimaar bhi,
Kaneezan e Zainab Hain Shamil Sabhi
Liye Karwaan-e-Aza. Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
7) Bulaye Hain Ham Sabko Ibne Ali,
Labon Par Sadayein Hain Labbaik Ki,
Hai Matam Hussaini Bapa. Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-2
8) Muqarrib ke lab par hai ye ilteja,
Hai jawwad ki bhi ye maula Sada
Mujhe apne roza dikhadi. Chala Mai chala Karbala.
Najaf se Liye Khafela,
Chala mai Chala Karbala-3
